name: Report For Lemon Squeezy
author: ThemesVila

sections.description:
After activating this plugin, you will see a beautiful Lemon Squeezy Sales Report Dashboard inside your WordPress admin area.

This dashboard shows your total sales, revenue, refunds, top products, and customer insights — all in real time. No need to log in to your Lemon Squeezy account every time.

A few notes about the sections above:

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API to retrieve data.

Lemon Squeezy API

The plugin sends requests to the Lemon Squeezy API to fetch product, customer, and sales information.

Data sent:
– Your Lemon Squeezy API key (provided by the site admin only)
– Request parameters (product IDs, dates, etc.)

Data received:
– Product info, sales stats, customer details etc

Why this is needed:
– To display real-time sales analytics and reports inside the WordPress admin.

Service Provider:
Lemon Squeezy, LLC
Terms of Service: https://www.lemonsqueezy.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.lemonsqueezy.com/privacy
sections.faq:
This Plugin All Features is Free?

Yes, All features is free.

How Use this Plugin?

Just create an API key from your Lemon Squeezy account, enter it in the plugin settings, and your sales report will appear instantly.
